data.title: Vision Is Not Overhead: One-Pass Block Drafting for Lossless Speculative Decoding in Vision-Language Models
data.summary: GLANCEはfrozen VLM targetの融合済みvision-language stateからfuture token blockを1 passでdraftし、wide treeを1 target passで検証するlossless speculative decoder。grounded taskでautoregressive比最大2.93x。free-running textではchain drafterが優位となる境界も示す。
data.implementation: Official code: https://github.com/js-lee-AI/GLANCE. SGLang 0.5.6 production comparison.
